body_html:
Podcasting or
bronze casting
crafting  of your story
should be
rough draft of your glory
Yet the
paradox
of technology
lead to padlocks
on the soapbox


once artisic
holitstic
now undescriptive
and stripped of
synergistic differences


search of prescriptive
low friction
design instead of the
grind////of work
technology defined
as a mythology cast
by mystics
we are left with an often
sadistic
addiction and constriction
of self
every step
off.   the.   shelf
so a pre planned
ecology
startles me


Paradox of thought
lost,
caught
in the algorithm bought
and sold again
our hunt for ease
has created a disease
of identity
as they spy on me
where is the history
winthin me stuck in the blue box?


A Paradox of freedom
tautology of the feed
as they lead around masses
and what passes
for control leads
 to the trolls
so rise up,
spin your wheel
fire the kiln
we must begin
to take back the holisitc
strive for humane tech
revive and retain
our own spec
